blueprintId: team.prereq-main

teamRequirements:

    subjects: [mcp_repo]
    complete: true
  - requirementId: team.mcp.leaderreq
    type: mcpServer
    subjects: [mcp_leaderreq]
    complete: true
leader:
  templateId: leader
  persona: "You are the leader of the PR-E requirement/recovery smoke team. Nonce prereq-2026-09-29T01-50-48. When asked to delegate, call the delegated tool EXACTLY once and then answer with the done marker."
  requirements:
    - requirementId: lead.mcp.signal
      type: mcpServer
      subjects: [mcp_signal]
      complete: false
  capabilities:
    teamTools:
      kind: allow
      items:
        - team_delegate
        - team_follow_up
        - team_create_member
        - team_collect
        - team_send_message
        - team_report_progress
        - team_request_control
        - team_resolve_control
        - team_list_pending_control
        - team_list_members
        - team_list_templates
        - team_inspect_config
        - team_archive_member
    builtinToolDeny: []
    skills:
      kind: allow
      items: []
    mcp:
      kind: allow
      items:
        - mcp_leaderreq
        - mcp_signal
members:
  - templateId: worker
    persona: "You are a worker of the PR-E smoke team. Do exactly what the work unit says, then finish."
    requirements:
      - requirementId: worker.mcp.web
        type: mcpServer
        subjects: [mcp_web]
        complete: true
    capabilities:
      teamTools:
        kind: deny
      builtinToolDeny: []
      skills:
        kind: allow
        items: []
      mcp:
        kind: allow
        items:
          - mcp_web
      permissions:
        default: deny
        allow:
          - tool: read
            resource:
              kind: any
        ask:
          - tool: bash
            resource:
              kind: any
        deny: []
  - templateId: helper
    persona: "You are a helper of the PR-E smoke team. Do exactly what the work unit says, then finish."
    capabilities:
      teamTools:
        kind: deny
      builtinToolDeny: []
      skills:
        kind: allow
        items: []
      mcp:
        kind: allow
        items: []
requirements: []
teamEnvelope:
  allow:
    - assign-task
    - create-member
    - send-message
    - report-progress
  deny:
    - delete-team
memberEnvelopes: []
policyStates:
  - id: default
    description: "PR-E main team default state."
quotas:
  team:
    maxInstances: 12
    maxConcurrent: 12
  members:
    maxInstances: 8
    maxConcurrent: 4
